svg.title: Insurance updates after a separation in Canada
svg.desc: Six records to change so they match the separation agreement: life insurance beneficiary and owner, auto policies and addresses, home or tenant cover during the move, workplace health and dental, online portal access, and the written checklist from the lawyer or mediator.
svg.text: The agreement is the promise. The insurer file has to match.
A divorce order does not, by itself, rewrite a beneficiary. Education only. Not family-law advice.
Beneficiary and owner, only as the settlement requires
Each car on a policy that matches who drives it and where it sleeps
Home policy for the person who stays; tenant policy the day the other moves
Health and dental: read who the booklet still calls a spouse
Remove portal access, the old email, and a joint premium debit
Lawyer or mediator checks the file against the signed agreement
An irrevocable beneficiary usually cannot be removed without that person's consent.
Ontario's Court of Appeal has said nothing happens automatically on divorce. A general release is not a new designation.
Keep both policies in force on the day of the move. A bare day is not a saving.
